8127.title: Unchanged marketplace refresh downloads Git repositories again
8127.rootCauseOneLine: Git materialization ignores the persisted commit and always performs an unfiltered clone followed by a full checkout.

prReviews.verdict: Targets root cause — static inspection only
prReviews.topFinding: Open ready PR closes this issue and adds commit-aware reuse and bounded materialization; no PR code or tests were executed.

8127.proposedFix: Reuse the validated cached catalog when the remote commit matches the persisted commit; bound changed-commit transfers and preserve cached local icons.
8127.caveats: Large-remote timing and pack-byte claims were not benchmarked. No duplicate fix PR opened because ready PR #8128 already closes the issue.
